Definition: to wait; by implication, to be patient, hope
BiblicalUsage: 1) to wait, hope, expect; 1a) (Niphal) to wait; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to wait, await, tarry; 1b2) to wait for, hope for; 1c) (Hiphil) to wait, tarry, wait for, hope for
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
